reasoning: Both implement the same correct design (event-driven counts, spatial grid hover, dirty-flag panel) with honest reports. A keeps the diff minimal and writes Adornee only when the hover changes. B rewrites unrelated lines with const and a new require style, which adds churn and possible runtime risk even though the checks pass. A is the cleaner merge.
